title: Merion Mercy Academy
subtitle: Concord & Salem, MA March 21-24, 2027
bodyHtml:
Families, you are currently viewing a sample itinerary customized for Merion Mercy Academy. Please note that this version is meant to provide a general overview of the experiences and activities the trip organizers hope to include. As we get closer to departure, the school or designated trip organizer will share the most up-to-date and finalized itinerary, reflecting any adjustments, confirmed reservations, and timing updates. For now, please enjoy this preview of what is planned for your student’s upcoming trip.

Day 1: Travel to Concord, MA & Louisa May Alcott’s Orchard House

  • Travel to Concord, MA!
  • Visit the Walden Pond State Reservation
  • Visit Louisa May Alcott’s Orchard House
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 2: Historic Walking Tour of Concord & Old Manse

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Visit the Concord Museum
  • Lunch
  • Historic Walking Tour of Concord
  • Visit the Old Manse
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations 
 

Day 3: The House of Seven Gables & Salem Witch Museum

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Landmark Leader Led Walking Tour of Salem
  • Guided Tour of The House of Seven Gables
  • Old Burying Point Cemetery at Salem Witch Museum
  • Visit the Salem Witch Museum
  • Watch a Performance at History Alive: Cry Innocent 
  • Free Time in Salem
  • Group sit-down dinner
  • SALEM Guided Ghost Tour
  • Return to Hotel Accommodations

Day 4: Peabody Essex Museum & Departure for Home

  • Breakfast at the hotel
  • Guided Tour of Peabody Essex Museum
  • Depart for Home
introHeading: Merion Mercy Academy, get ready for an unforgettable Concord and Salem adventure in 2027!
introText: Get ready for a New England adventure packed with literary history, colonial mysteries, and unforgettable experiences! Students will stroll the peaceful shores of Walden Pond, step into the world of Louisa May Alcott at her iconic Orchard House, and explore the rich exhibits of the Peabody Essex Museum. They'll also discover the haunting history of the Salem Witch Museum, walk the storied paths of Old Burying Point Cemetery, and experience the dramatic performance of History Alive: Cry Innocent. From Concord to Salem, this is the perfect blend of education, culture, and excitement your students will never forget!
